He is currently pursuing his Ph.D. at Annamalai University and holds postgraduate degrees in commerce and business administration. His commitment lies in fostering innovation, critical thinking and research among students in the fields of finance, marketing and taxation. With a dynamic approach to pedagogy, he actively contributes to curriculum development, authorship and academic enrichment through resource material creation and scholarly publications.
